decision.reasoning_trace: During my search, I encountered many products that were actually accessories (cases, charging cables, wall mounts) rather than speakers, which I filtered out. I selected five actual speakers for serious consideration, ranging from ultra-portable budget options like the EWA A106 Pro to more premium offerings from Bose and JBL. I decided to purchase the JBL Clip 3 because it has an incredible reputation with over 68,000 reviews and a high 4.7 rating. Its specific feature set—waterproof design, integrated carabiner, and 10-hour battery life—makes it the most reliable and versatile portable speaker in this list for its price point.
